name: Understand Anything (Lum1104)
hook: "Graphs that teach > graphs that impress" — v2.7.3, ~25k stars. Parses every file, function, class, and dependency into an interactive web dashboard with clickable nodes that surface plain-English summaries. /understand-chat answers architecture questions; /understand-diff shows the blast-radius of any PR; /understand-onboard generates a guided tour for new teammates. Works as a Claude Code plugin and across Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, and Antigravity — one install.sh auto-detects all of them.
install: /plugin marketplace add Lum1104/Understand-Anything  # or: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lum1104/Understand-Anything/main/install.sh | bash

name: CodeGraph (colbymchenry)
hook: 26.6k stars, +14k in one week (AI Weekly). Builds a pre-indexed SQLite-backed symbol graph and call graph of your codebase, then exposes it to Claude Code via an MCP server. Benchmarked across 6 real-world repos: 92% fewer tool calls and 71% faster exploration on average. 100% local, 19+ languages, framework-aware route detection for 13 frameworks, auto-syncs via native OS file watchers. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and Hermes Agent — no external API key required.

name: code-review-graph (tirth8205)
hook: 15.6k stars, 70 contributors. Tree-sitter-powered local code intelligence graph exposed as an MCP server + CLI. Benchmarked: 6.8× fewer tokens on code reviews and up to 49× on daily coding tasks. The install step auto-detects every AI coding tool you have installed (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, OpenCode) and writes the correct MCP config for each — no manual JSON. 31+ languages supported including Solidity, Zig, Dart, and Jupyter notebooks.
install: pip install code-review-graph && code-review-graph install && code-review-graph build

name: notebooklm-py (teng-lin)
hook: 15.2k stars, v0.5.0 released May 24. Unofficial Python SDK and agentic skill for Google NotebookLM that exposes capabilities the web UI doesn't: programmatic notebook creation, source ingestion, and artifact generation in 9 formats (MP3 podcast, MP4 video, PDF summary, PNG infographic, CSV, structured Markdown, flashcards, quizzes, and mind-maps). Ships as a Claude Code skill, Codex tool, and OpenClaw plugin. Chase AI named "NotebookLM CLI" one of the top-10 Claude Code tools to install first in 2026.
install: pip install "notebooklm-py[browser]" && playwright install chromium && notebooklm login

name: Skill Seekers (yusufkaraaslan)
hook: 13.8k stars, v3.6.0. Universal preprocessing layer that ingests 18 source types — documentation sites, GitHub repos, PDFs, YouTube videos, Jupyter notebooks, OpenAPI specs, Confluence, Notion, Slack/Discord archives, EPUB books, man pages, RSS feeds, local codebases, and more — and converts them into structured skills deployable across 12 LLM platforms and 8 RAG frameworks. Ships 26 MCP tools for use with Claude Code. Companion GitHub Action (skill-seekers-action) transforms any doc source into a fresh skill on every push. Reduces doc preprocessing from days to 15-45 minutes.

name: Claude Context (Zilliz)
hook: 11.6k stars, 210 commits. Exposes your entire codebase as a semantic search MCP server — hybrid BM25 + dense-vector retrieval stores code in Milvus or Zilliz Cloud and returns only the relevant snippets. Benchmarked 40% token reduction at equivalent retrieval quality versus naive file-loading. Supports 14 languages, 5 embedding providers (OpenAI, VoyageAI, Ollama, Gemini, local). First appeared in the May 1 digest; revisiting as token costs remain the top Claude Code pain point and the project has since added 28 tracked releases.

name: knowledge-work-plugins (Anthropic)
hook: 7.6k stars. Anthropic's official open-source collection of 11 job-function plugins — sales, product management, engineering, data analysis, marketing, legal, customer support, finance, life sciences research, productivity, and a starter template. Each bundles domain skills (auto-activated when Claude detects relevant context), slash commands, and MCP connectors to the external tools each role relies on. Updated May 25; works in both Claude Cowork and Claude Code. Apache 2.0 — fork and customize the skills, connectors, and commands for your team's specific tools.
install: claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins && claude plugin install sales@knowledge-work-plugins

name: Claude Squad (smtg-ai)
hook: 7.4k stars. Terminal TUI that runs multiple Claude Code, Codex, Aider, Gemini CLI, or OpenCode agents simultaneously — each in its own tmux session with an isolated git worktree, so parallel agents work on separate branches and can never clobber each other. Auto-accept ("yolo") mode for unattended overnight runs. Single dashboard to monitor status, scroll preview output, and inspect diffs without juggling terminal windows. Updated March-April 2026.
